newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish bonds end stronger, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bonds end stronger, more gains seen.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Bonos power ahead on Thursday, ending higher with other European markets. Long future closed above 117.80 suggesting tomorrow more gains likely, dealers said.
* 10-yr 7.35 pct T-bond 108.21 vs 107.73, yield 6.19 vs 6.26 * Sept bond future 117.80 vs 117.34 at yesterday's close
